title: Night Signal
description: A glossy, melody-led dance track that unfolds across a slow-burn arc — a shimmer of supersaw chords emerging from sparse drums, building through a glittering mid-groove peak, and dissolving into a drifting late-night outro. The OberheimDMX kit gives the rhythm a warm, slightly analog snap beneath the soaring lead.
